dedupe_keys.name: traffic counts key figures and traffic noise data from mastra vejdirektoratet on open data dk

description: The Danish Road Directorate publishes two datasets from Mastra, the nationwide traffic count system shared with the municipalities, on the Open Data DK portal. The organisation page read on 2026-09-28 lists "Traffic counts - key figures", annual traffic figures from the counts collected by the municipalities and the Road Directorate, and "Traffic noise", traffic figures arranged as the starting point for noise calculations with common models and generated from the same counts; each is offered as XLSX, GeoJSON, CSV and Shapefile. Coverage is national, for state roads and the municipal roads counted in Mastra, at count-point level. Access is free download. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-4.0 (licence field of the Vejdirektoratet datasets on opendata.dk). Caveats: key figures are annual summaries (typically annual daily traffic and vehicle shares), not hourly counts, and municipal coverage varies. It supports traffic demand calibration for road network flow models and capacity planning, and exposure of traffic to road closures. Related records: data-vejdirektoratet-dataudveksleren-portal is the directorate's own data portal and data-denmark-road-weather-feeds its road weather data.
